properties.citation: Colony and Protectorate of Kenya, Statistical Abstract 1960, Nairobi, p. vii and Table 16 « Population Census, 1948 — Main Tribes » (Kikuyu 1,026,341), Kenya National Bureau of Statistics scan. Natural Earth, Admin 0 Countries, feature KEN.
properties.derivation: Built by social/video/areas.mjs: the Natural Earth 1:50m polygon of Kenya (ADM0_A3 KEN), exterior ring only; on a 0.05° grid (cells whose centre falls inside), traced back as the cell boundary, simplified by Douglas–Peucker at 0.05° and rounded to 0.01°; parts and holes under 5000 km² dropped. The colony of 1948 had this border on the scale of the map; the Ilemi triangle's changes are under a few pixels.
